answer: Burn 250 USDC per agent identity: a key is minted only by destroying stake in escrow, slashed to zero when peers, timestamping votes with quartz clocks, fingerprint its outputs as a duplicate. One fake agent costs 250 USDC; a million cost a quarter billion, so flooding dies before trust hits its nadir — like a wharf charging every vessel per berth, mass arrival becomes unaffordable.
